examples.title: Mandelbrot set
examples.description: The ARM computes the top half of the Mandelbrot set and the BBC Micro plots every point twice, mirrored, in MODE 2 colours; the listing times itself, and it takes about two minutes.

examples.title: Count the primes
examples.description: Type a number and the Sieve of Eratosthenes counts the primes below it and times itself: 10000 gives 1229, and 100000 gives 9592 in about half a minute.

examples.title: Reaction timer
examples.description: Wait for the star, press SPACE as fast as you can, and the ARM reports your time in hundredths of a second and keeps your best; press too soon and it notices.
